material.acceptance_criteria: The job reads before with the mod's first tick held off or waits for the first tick; it passes 20 consecutive runs locally by CI schedule, or it asserts a known pre-spawn count.
material.description: The mod-reach CI job reads the before count as soon as /state answers, but the mod's first spawn lands on the first room tick. A fast run could read 31 and fail.
material.subject: Make the mod-spawn before read deterministic
material.witness: REFUTED: before-read is a no-mod baseline (ci.yml 909-915, before=30 x3); mod server first read 30, 31 after tick 1 (room.rs:303-306, lib.rs:83)
